tonight.headline: Tuten still has no net, and Friday's practice decides how much that matters
body: Bad news first: your lineup has not changed since Wednesday afternoon. Tuten is still in an RB slot after a limited Wednesday and a missed Thursday practice, and every back on your bench locks at 12:00 Sunday. If Jacksonville declare him inactive at 13:55, nobody can replace him. The fix is the same one-minute move as yesterday: Gordon to RB, Tuten to FLEX, Diggs to the bench (Do-first). It is also the projection lineup.

Thursday night is in: Fairbairn 6.0 (three extra points and a 27-yard field goal in Houston's 26-3 win, Houston Chronicle via Yahoo). Panda Attack's Dalton Schultz scored 2.1. ESPN projects 132.0 to 121.7 and gives you 55%.

case.body: Tuten inactive at 13:55 with the lineup still as set: 17.0 projected points become zero. Friday's practice line lands after this run.

case.label: The problem
case.body: At the 12:50Z snapshot Tuten is still in an RB slot (slot column, league file) and no AVIATO lineup move has happened since 18 Nov 20:35Z (activity log). Gordon plays at Buffalo and Etienne at Chicago, both at 12:00. Jacksonville–New York kicks off at 15:25, and inactives come at 13:55, after both backs have locked.

case.label: Where Tuten stands
case.body: Limited Wednesday, did not practise Thursday (ankle/foot). Jaguars On SI (19 Nov 22:43Z): he has played each of the last two games after practising only once that week, Coen called him 'still not quite 100%' after 26 carries, and the expectation is that he plays. Friday's line is not out yet at 07:00.

case.label: The fallbacks
case.body: Waddle has been a full participant all week and cleared the concussion protocol (DenverBroncos.com 19 Nov; sicscore). Denver play at 15:25. Diggs took a rest-day DNP Thursday, not an injury (Athlon 19 Nov), and plays Monday. Both are still unlocked at 13:55, but only for a FLEX slot.

case.label: The fix
case.body: Gordon (13.9) into an RB slot, Tuten (17.0) into FLEX, Diggs (13.0) to the bench. That is the lineup check's projection lineup. Gordon over Diggs is a 0.9 coin flip, taken by rule.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is inactive and the slot still scores zero because the swap was not made before 12:00. The Gordon-over-Diggs choice inside it is a coin flip and is not graded as a thesis.
